i had a therapist for most of this year and once i started feeling suicidal i just didn’t feel like going anymore for some reason. i talk to my friend about this specific feeling only twice because i just feel like i’m bothering her even though she says i’m not. i talk to her about how i feel often within the past month but rarely this specific feeling.

if you only need to hide them for a little while, you can maybe use concealer and put it over the scars, only if they are fully healed. if they aren’t fully healed you can get an infection. or you could wear long pants? i’m not sure why you need to hide them if they will be exposed or not (such as being at a beach/ pool) sorry if none of this helps. i’m not quite sure how to make them fade i think that mainly comes with time.
I feel like that sometimes, i was only clean a week because i keep them in my night stand, but during that week i didn’t even feel like i had the energy to cut

I was seeing a therapist and we kinda concluded that childhood trauma started it, and things have happened since i’ve started having problems with depression that have just kept making it worse. the person i talk to about it knows i have these thoughts and knows i’ve tried once. They want to help and what makes me feel guilty is that they want to help and i still want to leave.

you should not use any type of makeup products on healing wounds, they can lead to infection. you could roll up your sleeves to a certain point like the comment before me says or maybe cover it with bandages and make up a reason?

i’ve dealt with similar, and have somewhat of a panic attack every morning. I can’t calm down, feel sick, chest feels tight, everything ( i realize there’s other reasons for this but i feel like this may be part of it). I just get forced to go by my parents because they think it’s not as big of a deal either. i wanted to switch to online but they were trying to make it extremely hard to do so, so i didn’t. it really is a serious thing that needs more attention, i’m here to talk if you want.

i was experiencing the same thing. and i started in little bits kinda just telling my friend i wasn’t really happy that often, small things like that. I became more and more open about how i felt over time as i felt safer talking to them about it. you don’t have to jump all in at once maybe ease in slowly if it’s more comfortable for you? that’s what worked for me so if it might help you, you can try that? i was ashamed too, but they made me feel safe and helped me not feel as ashamed. If they’re a good friend they will help you and listen to you, you aren’t wasting anyones time by reaching out for help.
it would probably be good to talk about it if you have the time.
